$comment: Environment guard for the optimizely-cms-saas MCP server and cms:push. Read by .claude/hooks/optimizely-guard.mjs. Testing values are ALSO re-derived from .env at every check; this file only adds what .env cannot express (the production fingerprint). production.appHosts must list EVERY production site host: the fingerprint fails if any of them appears.
fingerprintQuery: query EslEnvFingerprint { _Content(where: { _metadata: { types: { in: ["EslStartPage"] } } }, limit: 10) { total items { _metadata { key displayName url { base } } } } }
